name: Asahi
source:
"Asahi... yeah, I'd like you to call me that."

A boy Maito meets on the cherry blossom hill. Except for his name, everything about him is unclear. He holds the key to the story. He knows Maito's past.

[From the [url=https://project-navel.com/sorechiru/character19.html]official site[/url]]
